verses.en: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
verses.pt: Portanto, se há alguma exortação em Cristo, se alguma consolação de amor, se alguma comunhão do Espírito, se alguns entranháveis afetos e compaixões,
verses.en_web: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
verses.en_bbe: If then there is any comfort in Christ, any help given by love, any uniting of hearts in the Spirit, any loving mercies and pity,

verses.en: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
verses.pt: completai o meu gozo, para que tenhais o mesmo modo de pensar, tendo o mesmo amor, o mesmo ânimo, pensando a mesma coisa;
verses.en_web: make my joy full, by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
verses.en_bbe: Make my joy complete by being of the same mind, having the same love, being in harmony and of one mind;

verses.en: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
verses.pt: nada façais por contenda ou por vanglória, mas com humildade cada um considere os outros superiores a si mesmo;
verses.en_web: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
verses.en_bbe: Doing nothing through envy or through pride, but with low thoughts of self let everyone take others to be better than himself;

verses.en: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
verses.pt: não olhe cada um somente para o que é seu, mas cada qual também para o que é dos outros.
verses.en_web: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
verses.en_bbe: Not looking everyone to his private good, but keeping in mind the things of others.

verses.en: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
verses.pt: Tende em vós aquele sentimento que houve também em Cristo Jesus,
verses.en_web: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
verses.en_bbe: Let this mind be in you which was in Christ Jesus,

verses.en: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
verses.pt: o qual, subsistindo em forma de Deus, não considerou o ser igual a Deus coisa a que se devia aferrar,
verses.en_web: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
verses.en_bbe: To whom, though himself in the form of God, it did not seem that to take for oneself was to be like God;

verses.en: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
verses.pt: mas esvaziou-se a si mesmo, tomando a forma de servo, tornando-se semelhante aos homens;
verses.en_web: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
verses.en_bbe: But he made himself as nothing, taking the form of a servant, being made like men;

verses.en: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
verses.pt: e, achado na forma de homem, humilhou-se a si mesmo, tornando-se obediente até a morte, e morte de cruz.
verses.en_web: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to death, yes, the death of the cross.
verses.en_bbe: And being seen in form as a man, he took the lowest place, and let himself be put to death, even the death of the cross.

verses.en: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
verses.pt: Pelo que também Deus o exaltou soberanamente, e lhe deu o nome que é sobre todo nome;
verses.en_web: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name;
verses.en_bbe: For this reason God has put him in the highest place and has given to him the name which is greater than every name;

verses.en: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
verses.pt: para que ao nome de Jesus se dobre todo joelho dos que estão nos céus, e na terra, e debaixo da terra,
verses.en_web: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
verses.en_bbe: So that at the name of Jesus every knee may be bent, of those in heaven and those on earth and those in the underworld,

verses.en: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.pt: e toda língua confesse que Jesus Cristo é Senhor, para glória de Deus Pai.
verses.en_web: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.en_bbe: And that every tongue may give witness that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

verses.en: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
verses.pt: De sorte que, meus amados, do modo como sempre obedecestes, não como na minha presença somente, mas muito mais agora na minha ausência, efetuai a vossa salvação com temor e tremor;
verses.en_web: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
verses.en_bbe: So then, my loved ones, as you have at all times done what I say, not only when I am present, but now much more when I am not with you, give yourselves to working out your salvation with fear in your hearts;

verses.en: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
verses.pt: porque Deus é o que opera em vós tanto o querer como o efetuar, segundo a sua boa vontade.
verses.en_web: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
verses.en_bbe: For it is God who is the cause of your desires and of your acts, for his good pleasure.

verses.en: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
verses.pt: Fazei todas as coisas sem murmurações nem contendas;
verses.en_web: Do all things without murmurings and disputes,
verses.en_bbe: Do all things without protests and arguments;

verses.en: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
verses.pt: para que vos torneis irrepreensíveis e sinceros, filhos de Deus imaculados no meio de uma geração corrupta e perversa, entre a qual resplandeceis como luminares no mundo,
verses.en_web: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,
verses.en_bbe: So that you may be holy and gentle, children of God without sin in a twisted and foolish generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

verses.en: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
verses.pt: retendo a palavra da vida; para que no dia de Cristo eu tenha motivo de gloriar-me de que não foi em vão que corri nem em vão que trabalhei.
verses.en_web: holding up the word of life; that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ, that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.
verses.en_bbe: Offering the word of life; so that I may have glory in you in the day of Christ, because my running was not for nothing and my work was not without effect.

verses.en: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
verses.pt: Contudo, ainda que eu seja derramado como libação sobre o sacrifício e serviço da vossa fé, folgo e me regozijo com todos vós;
verses.en_web: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice, and rejoice with you all.
verses.en_bbe: And even if I am offered like a drink offering, giving myself for the cause and work of your faith, I am glad and have joy with you all:

verses.en: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
verses.pt: e pela mesma razão folgai vós também e regozijai-vos comigo.
verses.en_web: In the same way, you also rejoice, and rejoice with me.
verses.en_bbe: And in the same way do you be glad and have a part in my joy.

verses.en: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
verses.pt: Ora, espero no Senhor Jesus enviar-vos em breve Timóteo, para que também eu esteja de bom ânimo, sabendo as vossas notícias.
verses.en_web: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
verses.en_bbe: But I am hoping in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you before long, so that I may be comforted when I have news of you.

verses.en: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
verses.pt: Porque nenhum outro tenho de igual sentimento, que sinceramente cuide do vosso bem-estar.
verses.en_web: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.
verses.en_bbe: For I have no man of like mind who will truly have care for you.

verses.en: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ’s.
verses.pt: Pois todos buscam o que é seu, e não o que é de Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: For they all go after what is theirs, not after the things of Christ.

verses.en: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
verses.pt: Mas sabeis que provas deu ele de si; que, como filho ao pai, serviu comigo a favor do evangelho.
verses.en_web: But you know the proof of him, that, as a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
verses.en_bbe: But his quality is clear to you; how, as a child is to its father, so he was a help to me in the work of the good news.

verses.en: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
verses.pt: A este, pois, espero enviar logo que eu tenha visto como há de ser o meu caso;
verses.en_web: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.
verses.en_bbe: Him then I am hoping to send as quickly as possible, when I am able to see how things will go for me:

verses.en: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
verses.pt: confio, porém, no Senhor, que também eu mesmo em breve irei.
verses.en_web: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
verses.en_bbe: But I have faith in the Lord that I myself will come before long.

verses.en: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellow soldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
verses.pt: Julguei, contudo, necessário enviar-vos Epafrodito, meu irmão, e cooperador, e companheiro nas lutas, e vosso enviado para me socorrer nas minhas necessidades;
verses.en_web: But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need;
verses.en_bbe: But it seemed to me necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, who has taken part with me in the work and in the fight, and your servant, sent by you for help in my need;

verses.en: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
verses.pt: porquanto ele tinha saudades de vós todos, e estava angustiado por terdes ouvido que estivera doente.
verses.en_web: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled, because you had heard that he was sick.
verses.en_bbe: Because his heart was with you all, and he was greatly troubled because you had news that he was ill:

verses.en: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
verses.pt: Pois de fato esteve doente e quase à morte; mas Deus se compadeceu dele, e não somente dele, mas também de mim, para que eu não tivesse tristeza sobre tristeza.
verses.en_web: For indeed he was sick, nearly to death, but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.
verses.en_bbe: For in fact he was ill almost to death: but God had mercy on him; and not only on him but on me, so that I might not have grief on grief.

verses.en: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
verses.pt: Por isso vo-lo envio com mais urgência, para que, vendo-o outra vez, vos regozijeis, e eu tenha menos tristeza.
verses.en_web: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that, when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
verses.en_bbe: I have sent him, then, the more gladly, so that when you see him again, you may be happy and I may have the less sorrow.

verses.en: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
verses.pt: Recebei-o, pois, no Senhor com todo o gozo, e tende em honra a homens tais como ele;
verses.en_web: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such in honor,
verses.en_bbe: So take him to your hearts in the Lord with all joy, and give honour to such as he is:

verses.en: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
verses.pt: porque pela obra de Cristo chegou até as portas da morte, arriscando a sua vida para suprir-me o que faltava do vosso serviço.
verses.en_web: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
verses.en_bbe: Because for the work of Christ he was near to death, putting his life in danger to make your care for me complete.
